name: Super Skrull

abilityDetails.Falter: Rakibin bir sonraki saldırısının ıskalamasına sebep olur.
abilityDetails.Energy Vulnerability: Enerji Direncini azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen enerji hasarını artırır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Undermine: Aktifken saldırılar Otomatik Blok ile engellenemez.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Aptitude: Fury, Armor Up ve Precision etkilerinin gücünü artırır.
abilityDetails.Nova Flame: Aktifken enerji hasarı verir, blok yeterliliğini %50 azaltır ve Mükemmel Blok şansını kaldırır.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Nötralize en iyi cevap. Güç kazanımına ve 25sn'de bir gelen vacilo efektine dikkat et. Güç kontrolcüleri iyi çalışır. E2 kullanmasına izin verme — bloklansa bile ölümcül olabilir.
signatureAbility:
Self Sustaining Power
Against Tech Champions, when Super-Skrull would inflict a personal Incinerate Debuff he instead inflicts a matching Nova Flame Debuff.
While in Cosmic Energy Overload, Super-Skrull gains a Power Gain Buff, granting [1.5 - 7.1]% of a Bar or Power per second.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Immune to Shock, Incinerate, and Special Lock effects.
Fury Buffs also grant +[85.05] Block Penetration
Armor Up Buffs also grant +[144.74] Critical Resistance

abilitySections.title: Hypnotic Gaze
content: 10 seconds after the start of each fight, inflict a Falter Passive for 1 second.
This Falter starts paused and is unpaused when Super-Skrull is struck or the Opponent Misses.
When this Falter ends, inflict a non-stacking [916.67] Energy Vulnerability Passive for 22 seconds and start a Falter cooldown for 22 seconds. When this cooldown ends, reinflict the Falter.

abilitySections.title: Cosmic Energy Receptor Buffs - Max: 5
content: Every 1 second Super-Skrull reaches full Charge, and his next action creates an indefinite Buff, resetting the Charge.
Hitting the Opponent or their Block grants a +[1,360.96] Fury Buff.
Being struck by or Blocking an attack grants a +[523.81] Armor Up Buff.

abilitySections.title: Cosmic Energy Overload
content: Upon reaching his Cosmic Energy Receptor Buff limit, Super-Skrull enters Cosmic Energy Overload for 15 seconds, and cannot gain any more Cosmic Energy Receptor Buffs until it ends.
Super-Skrull gains additional non-stacking Buffs for 15 seconds based on the Armor Up or Fury Buffs active when he enters Overload.
3+ Armor Up Buffs: Gain a Vigilance Buff
6+ Armor Up Buffs: Gain an Unblockable Buff
3+ Fury Buffs: Gain an Undermine Buff
6+ Fury Buffs: Gain a Nova Fists Buff. While active, all attacks inflict a [3,827.7] Incinerate Debuff for 1.5 seconds.
All indefinite Cosmic Energy Receptor Buffs are removed when Overload ends.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - Invisible Boulder Toss
content: On activation, convert up to 5 Fury Buffs into +[523.81] Armor Up Buffs for 30 seconds and refresh any personal Vigilance and Undermine Buffs.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - Elastic Firestorm
content: On activation, convert up to 5 Armor Up Buffs into +[1,360.96] Fury Buffs.
Each hit inflicts a [11,908.4] Incinerate Debuff for 5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - For the Skrull Empire
content: Gain an indefinite non-stacking Aptitude Buff increasing the potency of future Armor Up, Fury, and Precision Buffs by 60%
100% chance to inflict a 3 second Stun Debuff

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Self Sustaining Power
content: Against Tech Champions, when Super-Skrull would inflict a personal Incinerate Debuff he instead inflicts a matching Nova Flame Debuff.
While in Cosmic Energy Overload, Super-Skrull gains a Power Gain Buff, granting [1.5 - 7.1]% of a Bar or Power per second.
